progressMeaning: ISA-01 and ISA-02 are complete. The former twelve-prompt estimate is withdrawn; the twelve labels are work packages executed through smaller child batches. No fixed total prompt count is asserted.
nextAction: Review Maximum Status Interval, Minimum Status Interval, Name and Operating State only; publish the supported four-entry result, verify GitHub, then stop.

coverage.definition: Named DMS entries only, not nested fields or established mappings.

iterationRecordsMeaning: Existing ISA labels retained as work-package records, not one-prompt workload promises.

batchPolicy.purpose: Conservative starting ceilings, not guarantees, completion quotas, or permission to omit content.
batchPolicy.denseNestedDefinitions: Split into named field or enum groups when necessary; a large composite is not one trivial item.
batchPolicy.overflowAction: Reduce before starting or preserve a supported named subset and explicitly assign its remainder; do not broaden a prompt to finish a whole parent package.
batchPolicy.publicationRepair: One bounded repair attempt within a batch. If unresolved, stop further semantic work, save exact evidence through a working GitHub write path, and name the specific repair as the next sole task. No unbounded debug loop or false publication claim.
batchPolicy.infrastructureRule: Reuse current workbook and publisher; do not combine source review with designing a new export/transport system.
batchPolicy.nextBatchNaming: Name the next exact subset in ordinary closeout; avoid a separate planning turn when the inventory already supports the split.

batchPartitionCheck.method: Compare child ID union with all original ISA-03 inventory members; no source semantics changed by scheduling.

registerOwnerPassMeaning: Inventory owner_pass retains the parent package. propertyBatches in this progress file supplies the smaller prompt-sized assignments without altering source evidence.
publicationRule: GitHub is authoritative. Verify actual committed evidence, workbook and current PITON; sandbox copies are supplementary. Publish saved evidence early when a separate binary-publication repair is needed.
completedTaskRule: ISA-01 census and ISA-02 source block remain complete. Exact child batches have their own completion status; a completed child does not automatically complete its parent. Level and Link Loss remain record-local questions.

documentationCheckpoint.task: Replace oversized one-prompt packages with bounded child batches and include verification/publication in workload sizing
